DeepSeek API: Get User Balance | One

www.withone.ai/knowledge/deep-seek/conn_mod_def::GJ2Ten440j0::0CGcHv_aQXqAXAyHrBt2uA
Behavior The API retrieves the authenticated user's current balance data. It returns whether the balance is sufficient for making API calls (is_available). It returns an array of balances (balance_infos) broken down by currency. Notes This endpoint has no path parameters, query parameters, or request body. All balance amounts are returned as strings in the response example/schema.
